pitch_routes.route: No official Amazon MGM Studios pitch or submission page found today. Amazon Studios stopped taking unsolicited script and concept submissions on 13 Apr 2018. UK execs (Edinburgh, Aug 2026) say they are open to shows at any stage, but no public intake route is documented.

briefs.title: Amazon Prime Video to significantly increase UK spend (Edinburgh TV Festival spotlight)
briefs.summary: Budgets and decisions now sit in the UK, and spend is rising in scripted and unscripted. Fozia Khan wants 'real-world', lightly formatted unscripted shows with prominent talent that sit alongside Last One Laughing. Shows must work across UK regions, and universal themes that travel are preferred.

commissioners.name: Fozia Khan
commissioners.title: Head of Unscripted Originals
commissioners.remit: UK unscripted originals (earlier titled Head of Unscripted, Amazon Studios UK). Slate has included All or Nothing: Arsenal, Clarkson's Farm, The Fake Sheikh and 007: Road to a Million.
commissioners.pitch_route: No public submission route; contact through an established production company
commissioners.notes: Spoke at Edinburgh TV Festival on 27 Aug 2026. The 2023 Content London page credits that slate to her team as 'oversees', not as personal commissions. Former Channel 4 commissioning editor.

commissioners.name: Tara Erer
commissioners.title: Head of UK Film and Unscripted Television and Northern European Originals, Prime Video
commissioners.remit: Original film and TV across the UK, Germany, Benelux, Nordics, Eastern Europe and Turkey; also manages the Global Formats team

commissioners.pitch_route: No public submission route; contact through an established production company
